parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State the systematic name of compound **R**.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
**R** is dissolved in $\text{CDCl}_3$ and analysed using carbon-13 and proton NMR spectroscopy.

• Predict the number of peaks that are seen in the carbon-13 NMR spectrum of **R**.

• Predict the number of peaks that are seen in the proton NMR spectrum of **R**.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
A separate sample of **R** is dissolved in $\text{D}_2\text{O}$. The proton NMR spectrum of this solution shows **one less** peak than is obtained in $\text{CDCl}_3$.
Explain why.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Compound **R** reacts separately with the four reagents shown in the table.

Complete the table by
• drawing the structures of the organic products formed,
• stating the type of reaction.
